description: This file contains functions and logic for formatting and ranking code snippets based on recency and size, specifically for use in an autocomplete feature within a development environment. It includes methods for trimming snippets to fit token limits, ranking snippets by a combined recency and size score, and managing token counts.

methods.name: formatOpenedFilesContext
methods.description: Formats a list of recently opened file snippets into a context that fits within remaining token limits, trimming and ranking snippets as needed.

methods.name: rankByScore
methods.description: Ranks snippets based on recency and size scores, returning the top snippets.

methods.name: getRecencyAndSizeScore
methods.description: Calculates a combined score based on recency and size for ranking snippets.

methods.name: setLogStats
methods.description: Sets logarithmic statistics for snippet sizes to normalize size scores.

methods.name: trimSnippetForContext
methods.description: Trims a code snippet to fit within a maximum token limit, pruning from the bottom if necessary.
